levels.surface: المظفر بن جعفر بن المظفر العلوي

notes: «أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link: the surface is the name alone (rule 7).
The Imam Musa is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator; the sentence after is his saying.
«وفي حديث آخر» gives a variant of the description with no names: not a route.
